correctness.rationale: For balanced f, initial-segment containment and the binomial p_s quantile force infeasibility below c_s t^2. For every f, the radius-neighborhood increment is bounded by a (2t+1)-layer binomial interval; Berry--Esseen is uniform over all n and intervals, and the normal interval mass is maximized at the allowable quantile boundary. The two sides meet exactly at c_s=4/[Phi^{-1}(1-2^{-s-1})]^2. All rounding and s<=2t restrictions are handled by fixed-s, t-to-infinity quantifiers. Exact finite integer certificates independently corroborate the enclosures.
